chunks: His words: "and no scattered pieces of its upper part."
Al-Qaza' means the small pieces scattered from the clouds.

key_terms.رَبَابُهَا: Its upper part or back (referring to the cloud)

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Qaza' mean in the context of Quranic cloud descriptions?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi’s commentary clarifies the meteorological imagery in the Quranic description of rain, defining 'qaza' as small, scattered cloud fragments to illustrate the gradual formation of precipitation. This lexical precision underscores the Shia scholarly tradition of linking linguistic nuance with natural phenomena to deepen the understanding of divine signs (ayat) in creation.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Here “al-qaza`” means small pieces of cloud scattered all round.
